propositions: rebar doctor lacks diagnostic surface for held or orphaned locks, requiring manual inspection of lock directories and owner stamps
A read-only lock-health section must be added to rebar doctor reporting held/free state, holder identity, holder liveness, and hold age for four lock legs without mutating lock state
Holder liveness must be determined only from the v2 owner stamp host/namespace/pid/start fields and must report unprobeable for foreign hosts or namespaces rather than guessing
Lock staleness must be determined solely by the existing rebar._store.lock_owner._mkdir_lock_is_stale function with no independent age threshold or pid probe logic in the new module
A stale lock with a dead holder must produce a lock_findings entry and cause rebar doctor to exit 1; a held lock with a live holder must produce only an INFO message and exit 0
The lock-health feature must be implemented in a new doctor_locks.py module under 800 LOC and must not be affected by rebar doctor --repair operations
